pages.title: Armor & Wearables
pages.text: Hexalia armor provides situational advantages rather than raw strength, enhancing mobility, resistance, and interaction with the world.

pages.title: Ghost Veil
pages.text: A spectral chestpiece that reduces how easily creatures detect you, making it useful for stealth and escape.

pages.title: Bogshade Boots
pages.text: Improves movement through wetlands, greatly increasing swim speed and granting additional speed on mud.

pages.title: Earplugs
pages.text: Protects the wearer from the harmful cries of Mandrakes, making them essential for safe harvesting.

pages.title: Talismans & Charms
pages.text: These small relics grant their gift while worn.

pages.title: Seafoam & Moonward
pages.text: The Seafoam Talisman steadily restores breath underwater. The Moonward Ring continually clears Blindness and Darkness.

pages.title: Heart & Feather
pages.text: The Witchheart Cluster grants two extra hearts. The Wyrd Feather gives a small chance to slip unharmed from a direct melee or projectile strike.

pages.title: Green Omen
pages.text: When you harvest a mature crop, the Green Omen sometimes doubles everything the crop would have dropped.

pages.title: Silkweave Set
pages.text: A lightweight set offering moderate protection while increasing resistance to magical damage per piece. Wearing the full set grants an additional bonus.

pages.title: Moonweave Set
pages.text: A refined set that provides strong protection against magical damage. Wearing the full set extends the duration of brews.

pages.title: Bloomwrap Set
pages.text: A nature-bound set where each piece grants a unique effect, rewarding flexible use rather than relying only on full-set bonuses.

pages.title: Bloomwrap — Upper Garments
pages.text: The Hat reduces knockback and grants resistance to stuns, while the Robes reflect a portion of incoming damage back to attackers.

pages.title: Bloomwrap — Lower Garments
pages.text: The Leggings grant regeneration when near flowers, and the Boots increase movement speed on leaves.
